pr_title: Add 3s timeout to embedding requests made during search
pr_body:
# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes #5032 

## What does this PR do?
- Add a 3-second timeout to embedding requests against a remote embedder made in the context of search. The timeout triggers when there are failing requests due to rate-limiting.
- Add a test of that timeout.

issue_context.title: Cancel embedding operations for hybrid search after a deadline is met
issue_context.body:
Currently, any embedding request Meilisearch makes to an embedding server will be retried up to 10 times, with exponential backoff.

The exponential backoff has a time limit of 2 minutes, so the longest theoretical wait time is about 20 minutes.
For indexing, this may be fine: when embedding millions of documents, it might be preferable to sometimes wait multiple minutes rather than cancel the whole operation.

For search, however, this is too long.
- For hybrid search, we want to fallback to full-text search after one second.
- For pure semantic search, we want to error after a couple seconds.

This task is about implementing that change. No API change is expected at this point.
